page_intro: The member directory for this family.
table_caption: Members of this family, with their district and membership status.
not_published_title: The member directory is not published yet
not_published_body: The directory is being prepared and is not open to the public yet. Nothing about your membership changes in the meantime, and no member details are shown on this page today.
invalid_request_title: That page could not be shown
invalid_request_body: The address asked for a page this directory does not serve. Directory pages are numbered, and at most {max} entries are shown at a time. Please open the directory from the start.
unavailable_title: The directory could not be loaded
unavailable_body: The directory is temporarily unavailable. This is a problem on our side — it does not mean the directory is empty, and nothing about anyone's membership has changed. Please try again in a few minutes.
past_end_title: You've reached the end of the directory
past_end_body: There are no more entries past this point. Go back to the first page to browse from the start.
